result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed, but there is one content defect: the discount badge on the second restaurant card under "Popular right now" reads "−0%", which is a meaningless value. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel item and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behaviour.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second "Popular right now" card (pizza image) shows "−0%". A zero-percent discount is meaningless and suggests a missing or uncomputed value, or a badge that should be hidden when there is no discount.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is zero or missing, and check the data binding or formatting so the real percentage (e.g. "−20%") is shown when a promotion exists.
